It executes for anyone who opens an asset list (e.g. /hardware), including superusers, on page load with no interaction. Since "customfields.create" can be granted to non-superusers, a lower-privileged user gets script execution in a superuser's session -> privilege escalation. STEPS TO REPRODUCE 1. As a user with "customfields.create", create a Custom Field named: `` 2. Add the field to a fieldset that is associated with an asset model. 3. Open `/hardware` -> the payload executes on load. DEMONSTRATED IMPACT An account holding ONLY "customfields.create" (HTTP 403 on /users) planted a payload that, when a superuser opened /hardware, issued an authenticated request in that session and granted the attacker's own account the "superuser" permission (afterwards: GET /users = 200, isSuperUser() = true). ROOT CAUSE - Blade {{ }} encodes the data-columns attribute, but the browser decodes it back before bootstrap-table reads the title; bootstrap-table then renders the header title unescaped because its table-level "escape" option defaults to false and is never enabled. (The per-column 'escape' => true covers cell values, not the header title.) ### Patches Patched in https://github.com/grokability/snipe-it/commit/58754e4e3b86b58a0c4523012ef04a2ae990d2c8", "ghsa_id": "GHSA-p9h3-gvpq-5539", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-09-24T18:19:30Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-p9h3-gvpq-5539", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-p9h3-gvpq-5539"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2026-62368"}], "nvd_published_at": null, "published_at": "2026-09-24T18:19:30Z", "references": ["https://github.com/grokability/snipe-it/security/advisories/GHSA-p9h3-gvpq-5539", "https://github.com/grokability/snipe-it/commit/58754e4e3b86b58a0c4523012ef04a2ae990d2c8", "https://github.com/grokability/snipe-it/releases/tag/v8.7.0", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-p9h3-gvpq-5539"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/grokability/snipe-it/security-advisories/GHSA-p9h3-gvpq-5539", "severity": "high", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/grokability/snipe-it", "summary": "Snipe-IT: Stored XSS via Custom Field name in asset-list column headers", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-09-24T18:19:31Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-p9h3-gvpq-5539", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "8.7.0", "package": {"ecosystem": "composer", "name": "snipe/snipe-it"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "< 8.7.0"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
